The main takeaway from our work is that

the large-N c limit of QCD is not only a good approximation to low-energy strong interactions, but also provides an important guidance to the construction of effective chiral Lagragian for weak interactions.
the large-N c limit of QCD can be used to make predictions of nonleptonic K decays and radiative weak decays that are independent of the strong chiral couplings and that can be tested by experiment.
